newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile blue chips rise amid wave of foreign orders.
newsitem.headline: Chile blue chips rise amid wave of foreign orders.

text.p: Chilean stocks on Wednesday closed sharply higher for the second straight day with the bolsa lifted by a wave of foreign buy orders, dealers said.
The rally is likely to extend into Thursday's session, they said.
The 40-share index finished 1.66 percent higher at 131.14 points. The general index rose 0.63 percent to 5,671.2 points.
Turnover swelled to 22.3 billion pesos, more than double volume on Tuesday.
Share prices jumped at the opening after news of steady May economic growth and strong June foreign trade figures.
In New York, Chilean-issued American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) generally showed stronger gains than the Dow Jones Industrial Average, which rose modestly.

Traders reported robust demand for telecom and power stocks. Cia Telecomunicaciones de Chile SA (CTC), Chile's largest telephone company, climbed more than four percent after sharp declines by regional telecom stocks last week.
